overview: Not part of the mustache spec: lambdas in this port receive a third argument that renders template text in the current context, the way mustache.js passes `render` to a section lambda.

tests.name: Render helper - Section
tests.desc: A lambda can render its section in the current context before working on it.

tests.name: Render helper - Lists
tests.desc: The helper renders nested sections too.

tests.name: Render helper - Alternate Delimiters
tests.desc: The helper renders with the tags in force at the section.

tests.name: Render helper - Answer is rendered again
tests.desc: Whatever the lambda answers is rendered as a template, so tags that came out of the data are read a second time.

tests.name: Render helper - Interpolation
tests.desc: An interpolated lambda gets the helper too; with no section text there is nothing to render.
